correctness.rationale: Exact orbit simplex criterion, intralayer and cross-layer distance maxima, and a complete uniform neighborhood-inclusion deletion sequence reduce each finite fixed-space model by explicit simplicial collapses to a cross-polytope sphere. The complement sign follows from a fixed-point-free involution and integral Lefschetz identity. Edge cases are included. The included replay separately confirms 55 direct cases, 55 mod-two homology calculations, 1,220 graph folding sequences and 28 face-poset collapse sequences; the proof, not those finite tests, covers all parameters.

value.rationale: This proves a natural all-scales equivariant topological phase diagram over all dimensions, not a narrow numerical example: every full-coordinate fixed space is a sphere of exact dimension \(\lfloor\lfloor r/2floor/(n-r)floor\), with arbitrarily large dimension jumps and an integral residual complement sign. The explicit variable-band reduction offers a structural mechanism relevant to symmetry-sensitive Rips topology beyond the earlier isolated radius.
